data.name: Unseen Devotion
data.description: A hidden priest can apply the Silent Spell and Still Spell feats to a spell he is about to cast %1 times per day. This does not alter the level of the spell or the casting time. This ability replaces one of the cleric's two 8th-level domain powers (his choice).|(1+floor((classlevel("Cleric")-8)/4))
